  target : String
deriving BEq, Repr, Inhabited

  hash k := mixHash (hash k.source) (hash k.target)

structure EdgeKeyContext where 
deriving Inhabited

inductive EdgeQuality where
  | collapsed
  | entangled
  | superposition
  | coherent
deriving BEq, Repr, Inhabited

structure QuantumState where
  alpha : Float
  beta : Float
  gamma : Float
  delta : Float
  entanglement_degree : Float
deriving Repr, Inhabited

def QuantumState.probability (s : QuantumState) : Float :=
  s.alpha * s.alpha + s.beta * s.beta + s.gamma * s.gamma + s.delta * s.delta

def QuantumState.magnitude (s : QuantumState) : Float :=
  Float.sqrt (s.probability)

structure NodeVersion where
  version : Nat
  timestamp : Int
  data : QuantumState
  properties : HashMap String String
deriving Repr, Inhabited

structure EdgeVersion where
  version : Nat
  timestamp : Int
  weight : Float
  quality : EdgeQuality
  metadata : HashMap String String
deriving Repr, Inhabited

structure TemporalNode where
  node_id : String
  versions : Array NodeVersion
  current_version : Nat
  created_at : Int
  last_modified : Int
deriving Repr, Inhabited

structure TemporalEdge where
  edge_id : String
  source : String
  target : String
  versions : Array EdgeVersion
  current_version : Nat
  valid_from : Int
  valid_to : Int
  created_at : Int
  last_modified : Int
deriving Repr, Inhabited

  timestamp : Int
  node_versions : HashMap String Nat
  edge_versions : HashMap EdgeKey Nat
  metadata : HashMap String String
deriving Repr, Inhabited

  timestamp : Int
  operation : String
  entity_type : String
  entity_id : String
  version_before : Option Nat
  version_after : Nat
deriving Repr, Inhabited

  nodes : Array TemporalNode
  edges : Array TemporalEdge
  query_time : Int
deriving Repr, Inhabited

structure TemporalGraph where
  nodes : HashMap String TemporalNode
  edges : HashMap EdgeKey TemporalEdge
  current_time : Int
  snapshots : Array GraphSnapshot
  history : Array HistoryEntry
  next_snapshot_id : Nat
  next_edge_id : Nat
deriving Repr, Inhabited

def MAX_TIMESTAMP : Int := 9223372036854775807

def TimestampToMillis (t : Int) : Int := t / 1000000

def MillisToTimestamp (m : Int) : Int := m * 1000000

def TimestampToSeconds (t : Int) : Float := (Int.toFloat t) / 1000000000.0

def SecondsToTimestamp (s : Float) : Int := Int.floor (s * 1000000000.0)

def QuantumState.init (a b c d e : Float) : QuantumState :=
  { alpha := a, beta := b, gamma := c, delta := d, entanglement_degree := e }

def QuantumState.clone (s : QuantumState) : QuantumState := s

def NodeVersion.init (v : Nat) (ts : Int) (d : QuantumState) : NodeVersion :=
  { version := v, timestamp := ts, data := d, properties := HashMap.empty }

def NodeVersion.setProperty (nv : NodeVersion) (k v : String) : NodeVersion :=
  { nv with properties := nv.properties.insert k v }

def NodeVersion.getProperty (nv : NodeVersion) (k : String) : Option String :=
  nv.properties.find? k

def NodeVersion.removeProperty (nv : NodeVersion) (k : String) : NodeVersion :=
  { nv with properties := nv.properties.erase k }

def NodeVersion.clone (nv : NodeVersion) : NodeVersion :=
  { nv with properties := nv.properties.clone }

def EdgeVersion.init (v : Nat) (ts : Int) (w : Float) (q : EdgeQuality) : EdgeVersion :=
  { version := v, timestamp := ts, weight := w, quality := q, metadata := HashMap.empty }

def EdgeVersion.setMetadata (ev : EdgeVersion) (k v : String) : EdgeVersion :=
  { ev with metadata := ev.metadata.insert k v }

def EdgeVersion.getMetadata (ev : EdgeVersion) (k : String) : Option String :=
  ev.metadata.find? k

def EdgeVersion.clone (ev : EdgeVersion) : EdgeVersion :=
  { ev with metadata := ev.metadata.clone }

def TemporalNode.init (id : String) (st : QuantumState) (ts : Int) : TemporalNode :=
  { 
    node_id := id, 
    versions := #[NodeVersion.init 0 ts st], 
    current_version := 0, 
    created_at := ts, 
    last_modified := ts 
  }

def TemporalNode.addVersion (tn : TemporalNode) (st : QuantumState) (ts : Int) : Except String TemporalNode :=
  if h : tn.versions.isEmpty then .error "NoVersions"
  else
    let last := tn.versions[tn.versions.size - 1]
    if ts < last.timestamp then .error "TimeTravelNotAllowed"
    else
      let nv := NodeVersion.init tn.versions.size ts st
      .ok { 
        versions := tn.versions.push nv, 
        current_version := tn.versions.size, 
        last_modified := ts 
      }

def TemporalNode.getVersion (tn : TemporalNode) (v : Nat) : Option NodeVersion :=
  if v < tn.versions.size then tn.versions.get? v else none

def TemporalNode.getVersionAt (tn : TemporalNode) (ts : Int) : Option NodeVersion :=
  let rec loop (l r : Nat) (res : Option NodeVersion) : Option NodeVersion :=
    if l > r then res
    else
      let mid := l + (r - l) / 2
      let ver := tn.versions[mid]
      if ver.timestamp <= ts then
        loop (mid + 1) r (some ver)
      else
        if mid = 0 then res
        else loop l (mid - 1) res
  loop 0 (tn.versions.size - 1) none

def TemporalNode.rollback (tn : TemporalNode) (target : Nat) : Except String TemporalNode :=
  if target >= tn.versions.size then .error "InvalidTarget"
  else
    let new_versions := tn.versions.shrink (target + 1)
    let last_ts := new_versions[target].timestamp
    .ok { 
      versions := new_versions, 
      current_version := target, 
      last_modified := last_ts 
    }

def TemporalEdge.init (id src tgt : String) (w : Float) (q : EdgeQuality) (ts : Int) : TemporalEdge :=
  { 
    edge_id := id, 
    source := src, 
    target := tgt, 
    versions := #[EdgeVersion.init 0 ts w q], 
    current_version := 0, 
    valid_from := ts, 
    valid_to := MAX_TIMESTAMP, 
    created_at := ts, 
    last_modified := ts 
  }

def TemporalEdge.initWithTimeRange (id src tgt : String) (w : Float) (q : EdgeQuality) (from to_ : Int) : TemporalEdge :=
  let base := TemporalEdge.init id src tgt w q from
  { base with valid_to := to_ }

def TemporalEdge.isValidAt (te : TemporalEdge) (ts : Int) : Bool :=
  ts >= te.valid_from && ts <= te.valid_to

def TemporalEdge.invalidate (te : TemporalEdge) (ts : Int) : TemporalEdge :=
  { te with valid_to := ts }

def TemporalEdge.addVersion (te : TemporalEdge) (w : Float) (q : EdgeQuality) (ts : Int) : Except String TemporalEdge :=
  if h : te.versions.isEmpty then .error "NoVersions"
  else
    let last := te.versions[te.versions.size - 1]
    if ts < last.timestamp then .error "TimeTravelNotAllowed"
    else
      let nv := EdgeVersion.init te.versions.size ts w q
      .ok { 
        versions := te.versions.push nv, 
        current_version := te.versions.size, 
        last_modified := ts 
      }

def TemporalEdge.getVersionAt (te : TemporalEdge) (ts : Int) : Option EdgeVersion :=
  if !te.isValidAt ts then none
  else
    let rec loop (l r : Nat) (res : Option EdgeVersion) : Option EdgeVersion :=
      if l > r then res
      else
        let mid := l + (r - l) / 2
        let ver := te.versions[mid]
        if ver.timestamp <= ts then
          loop (mid + 1) r (some ver)
        else
          if mid = 0 then res
          else loop l (mid - 1) res
    loop 0 (te.versions.size - 1) none

def TemporalEdge.rollback (te : TemporalEdge) (target : Nat) : Except String TemporalEdge :=
  if target >= te.versions.size then .error "InvalidTarget"
  else
    let new_versions := te.versions.shrink (target + 1)
    let last_ts := new_versions[target].timestamp
    .ok { 
      versions := new_versions, 
      current_version := target, 
      last_modified := last_ts 
    }

def GraphSnapshot.init (id : Nat) (ts : Int) : GraphSnapshot :=
  { 
    snapshot_id := id, 
    timestamp := ts, 
    node_versions := HashMap.empty, 
    edge_versions := HashMap.empty, 
    metadata := HashMap.empty 
  }

def TemporalGraph.init : TemporalGraph :=
  { 
    nodes := HashMap.empty, 
    edges := HashMap.empty, 
    current_time := 0, 
    snapshots := #[], 
    history := #[], 
    next_snapshot_id := 0, 
    next_edge_id := 0 
  }

def TemporalGraph.addNode (tg : TemporalGraph) (id : String) (st : QuantumState) : Except String TemporalGraph :=
  if tg.nodes.contains id then .error "NodeExists"
  else
    let n := TemporalNode.init id st tg.current_time
    .ok { tg with nodes := tg.nodes.insert id n }

def TemporalGraph.addEdge (tg : TemporalGraph) (src tgt : String) (w : Float) (q : EdgeQuality) : Except String TemporalGraph :=
  let k := { source := src, target := tgt }
  if tg.edges.contains k then .error "EdgeExists"
  else
    let eid := s!"edge_{tg.next_edge_id}_{src}_{tgt}"
    let e := TemporalEdge.init eid src tgt w q tg.current_time
    .ok { 
      tg with 
      edges := tg.edges.insert k e, 
      next_edge_id := tg.next_edge_id + 1 
    }

def TemporalGraph.updateNode (tg : TemporalGraph) (id : String) (st : QuantumState) : Except String TemporalGraph :=
  match tg.nodes.find? id with
  | none => .error "NodeNotFound"
  | some n =>
    match n.addVersion st tg.current_time with
    | .error e => .error e
    | .ok nn => .ok { tg with nodes := tg.nodes.insert id nn }

def TemporalGraph.updateEdge (tg : TemporalGraph) (src tgt : String) (w : Float) (q : EdgeQuality) : Except String TemporalGraph :=
  let k := { source := src, target := tgt }
  match tg.edges.find? k with
  | none => .error "EdgeNotFound"
  | some e =>
    match e.addVersion w q tg.current_time with
    | .error err => .error err
    | .ok ne => .ok { tg with edges := tg.edges.insert k ne }

def TemporalGraph.invalidateEdge (tg : TemporalGraph) (src tgt : String) : Except String TemporalGraph :=
  let k := { source := src, target := tgt }
  match tg.edges.find? k with
  | none => .error "EdgeNotFound"
  | some e => .ok { tg with edges := tg.edges.insert k (e.invalidate tg.current_time) }

def TemporalGraph.createSnapshot (tg : TemporalGraph) : TemporalGraph :=
  let sid := tg.next_snapshot_id
  let mut snap := GraphSnapshot.init sid tg.current_time
  for (id, n) in tg.nodes do
    match n.getVersionAt tg.current_time with
    | some v => snap := { snap with node_versions := snap.node_versions.insert id v.version }
    | none => ()
  for (k, e) in tg.edges do
    if e.isValidAt tg.current_time then
      match e.getVersionAt tg.current_time with
      | some v => snap := { snap with edge_versions := snap.edge_versions.insert k v.version }
      | none => ()
  { 
    tg with 
    snapshots := tg.snapshots.push snap, 
    next_snapshot_id := sid + 1 
  }

def TemporalGraph.restoreSnapshot (tg : TemporalGraph) (sid : Nat) : Except String TemporalGraph :=
  match tg.snapshots.find? (fun s => s.snapshot_id == sid) with
  | none => .error "SnapshotNotFound"
  | some snap =>
    let mut new_nodes := tg.nodes
    for (id, n) in tg.nodes do
      match snap.node_versions.find? id with
      | some v =>
        match n.rollback v with
        | .error e => return .error e
        | .ok nn => new_nodes := new_nodes.insert id nn
      | none => 
        if n.created_at > snap.timestamp then
          new_nodes := new_nodes.erase id
    let mut new_edges := tg.edges
    for (k, e) in tg.edges do
      match snap.edge_versions.find? k with
      | some v =>
        match e.rollback v with
        | .error e => return .error e
        | .ok ne => new_edges := new_edges.insert k ne
      | none =>
        if e.created_at > snap.timestamp then
          new_edges := new_edges.erase k
    .ok { tg with nodes := new_nodes, edges := new_edges }

def IsSortedTimestamps (vers : Array NodeVersion) : Prop :=
  ∀ i j, i < j → i < vers.size → j < vers.size → vers[i]!.timestamp ≤ vers[j]!.timestamp

def IsSortedTimestampsEdge (vers : Array EdgeVersion) : Prop :=
  ∀ i j, i < j → i < vers.size → j < vers.size → vers[i]!.timestamp ≤ vers[j]!.timestamp

theorem init_sorted (id : String) (st : QuantumState) (ts : Int) : IsSortedTimestamps (TemporalNode.init id st ts).versions := by
  intro i j h_ij h_i h_j
  have : i = 0 := by simp [TemporalNode.init, Array.get] at h_i; omega
  have : j = 0 := by simp [TemporalNode.init, Array.get] at h_j; omega
  rw [this, this]
  rfl

theorem addVersion_preserves_sorted (tn : TemporalNode) (h_sorted : IsSortedTimestamps tn.versions) (st : QuantumState) (ts : Int) (h_time : ts ≥ tn.versions[tn.versions.size - 1]!.timestamp) : IsSortedTimestamps ((TemporalNode.addVersion tn st ts).toOption.get!).versions := by
  cases h : tn.addVersion st ts
  case error e => contradiction
  case ok n =>
    intro i j h_ij h_i h_j
    simp [TemporalNode.addVersion, h] at h_i h_j
    by_cases h_j_last : j = n.versions.size - 1
    . rw [h_j_last]
      simp [Array.get]
      have : i < n.versions.size - 1 := by omega
      have h_prev : n.versions[i]!.timestamp ≤ n.versions[n.versions.size - 2]!.timestamp := by
        have : i < tn.versions.size := by omega
        have : (tn.versions.size - 2) < tn.versions.size := by omega
        apply h_sorted i (tn.versions.size - 2) (by omega) this (by omega)
        rw [Array.get] at h_prev
      calc
        n.versions[i]!.timestamp ≤ n.versions[n.versions.size - 2]!.timestamp := h_prev
        _ ≤ ts := h_time
        _ = n.versions[j]!.timestamp := by simp [TemporalNode.addVersion] at h; rfl
    . have : j < n.versions.size - 1 := by omega
      have h_mono := h_sorted i j h_ij (by omega) this
      rw [Array.get] at h_mono
      assumption

theorem rollback_preserves_sorted (tn : TemporalNode) (h_sorted : IsSortedTimestamps tn.versions) (target : Nat) (h_t : target < tn.versions.size) : IsSortedTimestamps ((TemporalNode.rollback tn target).toOption.get!).versions := by
  cases h : tn.rollback target
  case error e => contradiction
  case ok n =>
    intro i j h_ij h_i h_j
    simp [TemporalNode.rollback, h] at h_i h_j
    have h_sub : i < tn.versions.size ∧ j < tn.versions.size := by
      constructor
      . calc i < target + 1 := by assumption
        _ ≤ tn.versions.size := by apply Nat.succ_le_of_lt h_t
      . calc j < target + 1 := by assumption
        _ ≤ tn.versions.size := by apply Nat.succ_le_of_lt h_t
    exact h_sorted i j h_ij h_sub.1 h_sub.2

theorem edge_addVersion_preserves_sorted (te : TemporalEdge) (h_sorted : IsSortedTimestampsEdge te.versions) (w : Float) (q : EdgeQuality) (ts : Int) (h_time : ts ≥ te.versions[te.versions.size - 1]!.timestamp) : IsSortedTimestampsEdge ((TemporalEdge.addVersion te w q ts).toOption.get!).versions := by
  cases h : te.addVersion w q ts
  case error e => contradiction
  case ok e =>
    intro i j h_ij h_i h_j
    simp [TemporalEdge.addVersion, h] at h_i h_j
    by_cases h_j_last : j = e.versions.size - 1
    . rw [h_j_last]
      simp [Array.get]
      have : i < e.versions.size - 1 := by omega
      have h_prev : e.versions[i]!.timestamp ≤ e.versions[e.versions.size - 2]!.timestamp := by
        have : i < te.versions.size := by omega
        have : (te.versions.size - 2) < te.versions.size := by omega
        apply h_sorted i (te.versions.size - 2) (by omega) this (by omega)
        rw [Array.get] at h_prev
      calc
        e.versions[i]!.timestamp ≤ e.versions[e.versions.size - 2]!.timestamp := h_prev
        _ ≤ ts := h_time
        _ = e.versions[j]!.timestamp := by simp [TemporalEdge.addVersion] at h; rfl
    . have : j < e.versions.size - 1 := by omega
      have h_mono := h_sorted i j h_ij (by omega) this
      rw [Array.get] at h_mono
      assumption

theorem edge_rollback_preserves_sorted (te : TemporalEdge) (h_sorted : IsSortedTimestampsEdge te.versions) (target : Nat) (h_t : target < te.versions.size) : IsSortedTimestampsEdge ((TemporalEdge.rollback te target).toOption.get!).versions := by
  cases h : te.rollback target
  case error e => contradiction
  case ok e =>
    intro i j h_ij h_i h_j
    simp [TemporalEdge.rollback, h] at h_i h_j
    have h_sub : i < te.versions.size ∧ j < te.versions.size := by
      constructor
      . calc i < target + 1 := by assumption
        _ ≤ te.versions.size := by apply Nat.succ_le_of_lt h_t
      . calc j < target + 1 := by assumption
        _ ≤ te.versions.size := by apply Nat.succ_le_of_lt h_t
    exact h_sorted i j h_ij h_sub.1 h_sub.2

          else loop l (mid - 1) res
    loop 0 (te.versions.size - 1) none

def TemporalEdge.rollback (te : TemporalEdge) (target : Nat) : Except String TemporalEdge :=
  if target >= te.versions.size then .error "InvalidTarget"
  else
    let new_versions := te.versions.shrink (target + 1)
    let last_ts := new_versions[target].timestamp
    .ok { 
      versions := new_versions, 
      current_version := target, 
      last_modified := last_ts 
    }

def GraphSnapshot.init (id : Nat) (ts : Int) : GraphSnapshot :=
  { 
    snapshot_id := id, 
    timestamp := ts, 
    node_versions := HashMap.empty, 
    edge_versions := HashMap.empty, 
    metadata := HashMap.empty 
  }

def TemporalGraph.init : TemporalGraph :=
  { 
    nodes := HashMap.empty, 
    edges := HashMap.empty, 
    current_time := 0, 
    snapshots := #[], 
    history := #[], 
    next_snapshot_id := 0, 
    next_edge_id := 0 
  }

def TemporalGraph.addNode (tg : TemporalGraph) (id : String) (st : QuantumState) : Except String TemporalGraph :=
  if tg.nodes.contains id then .error "NodeExists"
  else
    let n := TemporalNode.init id st tg.current_time
    .ok { tg with nodes := tg.nodes.insert id n }

def TemporalGraph.addEdge (tg : TemporalGraph) (src tgt : String) (w : Float) (q : EdgeQuality) : Except String TemporalGraph :=
  let k := { source := src, target := tgt }
  if tg.edges.contains k then .error "EdgeExists"
  else
    let eid := s!"edge_{tg.next_edge_id}_{src}_{tgt}"
    let e := TemporalEdge.init eid src tgt w q tg.current_time
    .ok { 
      tg with 
      edges := tg.edges.insert k e, 
      next_edge_id := tg.next_edge_id + 1 
    }

def TemporalGraph.updateNode (tg : TemporalGraph) (id : String) (st : QuantumState) : Except String TemporalGraph :=
  match tg.nodes.find? id with
  | none => .error "NodeNotFound"
  | some n =>
    match n.addVersion st tg.current_time with
    | .error e => .error e
    | .ok nn => .ok { tg with nodes := tg.nodes.insert id nn }

def TemporalGraph.updateEdge (tg : TemporalGraph) (src tgt : String) (w : Float) (q : EdgeQuality) : Except String TemporalGraph :=
  let k := { source := src, target := tgt }
  match tg.edges.find? k with
  | none => .error "EdgeNotFound"
  | some e =>
    match e.addVersion w q tg.current_time with
    | .error err => .error err
    | .ok ne => .ok { tg with edges := tg.edges.insert k ne }

def TemporalGraph.invalidateEdge (tg : TemporalGraph) (src tgt : String) : Except String TemporalGraph :=
  let k := { source := src, target := tgt }
  match tg.edges.find? k with
  | none => .error "EdgeNotFound"
  | some e => .ok { tg with edges := tg.edges.insert k (e.invalidate tg.current_time) }

def TemporalGraph.createSnapshot (tg : TemporalGraph) : TemporalGraph :=
  let sid := tg.next_snapshot_id
  let mut snap := GraphSnapshot.init sid tg.current_time
  for (id, n) in tg.nodes do
    match n.getVersionAt tg.current_time with
    | some v => snap := { snap with node_versions := snap.node_versions.insert id v.version }
    | none => ()
  for (k, e) in tg.edges do
    if e.isValidAt tg.current_time then
      match e.getVersionAt tg.current_time with
      | some v => snap := { snap with edge_versions := snap.edge_versions.insert k v.version }
      | none => ()
  { 
    tg with 
    snapshots := tg.snapshots.push snap, 
    next_snapshot_id := sid + 1 
  }

def TemporalGraph.restoreSnapshot (tg : TemporalGraph) (sid : Nat) : Except String TemporalGraph :=
  match tg.snapshots.find? (fun s => s.snapshot_id == sid) with
  | none => .error "SnapshotNotFound"
  | some snap =>
    let mut new_nodes := tg.nodes
    for (id, n) in tg.nodes do
      match snap.node_versions.find? id with
      | some v =>
        match n.rollback v with
        | .error e => return .error e
        | .ok nn => new_nodes := new_nodes.insert id nn
      | none => 
        if n.created_at > snap.timestamp then
          new_nodes := new_nodes.erase id
    let mut new_edges := tg.edges
    for (k, e) in tg.edges do
      match snap.edge_versions.find? k with
      | some v =>
        match e.rollback v with
        | .error e => return .error e
        | .ok ne => new_edges := new_edges.insert k ne
      | none =>
        if e.created_at > snap.timestamp then
          new_edges := new_edges.erase k
    .ok { tg with nodes := new_nodes, edges := new_edges }

def IsSortedTimestamps (vers : Array NodeVersion) : Prop :=
  ∀ i j, i < j → i < vers.size → j < vers.size → vers[i]!.timestamp ≤ vers[j]!.timestamp

def IsSortedTimestampsEdge (vers : Array EdgeVersion) : Prop :=
  ∀ i j, i < j → i < vers.size → j < vers.size → vers[i]!.timestamp ≤ vers[j]!.timestamp

theorem init_sorted (id : String) (st : QuantumState) (ts : Int) : IsSortedTimestamps (TemporalNode.init id st ts).versions := by
  intro i j h_ij h_i h_j
  have : i = 0 := by simp [TemporalNode.init, Array.get] at h_i; omega
  have : j = 0 := by simp [TemporalNode.init, Array.get] at h_j; omega
  rw [this, this]
  rfl

theorem addVersion_preserves_sorted (tn : TemporalNode) (h_sorted : IsSortedTimestamps tn.versions) (st : QuantumState) (ts : Int) (h_time : ts ≥ tn.versions[tn.versions.size - 1]!.timestamp) : IsSortedTimestamps ((TemporalNode.addVersion tn st ts).toOption.get!).versions := by
  cases h : tn.addVersion st ts
  case error e => contradiction
  case ok n =>
    intro i j h_ij h_i h_j
    simp [TemporalNode.addVersion, h] at h_i h_j
    by_cases h_j_last : j = n.versions.size - 1
    . rw [h_j_last]
      simp [Array.get]
      have : i < n.versions.size - 1 := by omega
      have h_prev : n.versions[i]!.timestamp ≤ n.versions[n.versions.size - 2]!.timestamp := by
        have : i < tn.versions.size := by omega
        have : (tn.versions.size - 2) < tn.versions.size := by omega
        apply h_sorted i (tn.versions.size - 2) (by omega) this (by omega)
        rw [Array.get] at h_prev
      calc
        n.versions[i]!.timestamp ≤ n.versions[n.versions.size - 2]!.timestamp := h_prev
        _ ≤ ts := h_time
        _ = n.versions[j]!.timestamp := by simp [TemporalNode.addVersion] at h; rfl
    . have : j < n.versions.size - 1 := by omega
      have h_mono := h_sorted i j h_ij (by omega) this
      rw [Array.get] at h_mono
      assumption

theorem rollback_preserves_sorted (tn : TemporalNode) (h_sorted : IsSortedTimestamps tn.versions) (target : Nat) (h_t : target < tn.versions.size) : IsSortedTimestamps ((TemporalNode.rollback tn target).toOption.get!).versions := by
  cases h : tn.rollback target
  case error e => contradiction
  case ok n =>
    intro i j h_ij h_i h_j
    simp [TemporalNode.rollback, h] at h_i h_j
    have h_sub : i < tn.versions.size ∧ j < tn.versions.size := by
      constructor
      . calc i < target + 1 := by assumption
        _ ≤ tn.versions.size := by apply Nat.succ_le_of_lt h_t
      . calc j < target + 1 := by assumption
        _ ≤ tn.versions.size := by apply Nat.succ_le_of_lt h_t
    exact h_sorted i j h_ij h_sub.1 h_sub.2

theorem edge_addVersion_preserves_sorted (te : TemporalEdge) (h_sorted : IsSortedTimestampsEdge te.versions) (w : Float) (q : EdgeQuality) (ts : Int) (h_time : ts ≥ te.versions[te.versions.size - 1]!.timestamp) : IsSortedTimestampsEdge ((TemporalEdge.addVersion te w q ts).toOption.get!).versions := by
  cases h : te.addVersion w q ts
  case error e => contradiction
  case ok e =>
    intro i j h_ij h_i h_j
    simp [TemporalEdge.addVersion, h] at h_i h_j
    by_cases h_j_last : j = e.versions.size - 1
    . rw [h_j_last]
      simp [Array.get]
      have : i < e.versions.size - 1 := by omega
      have h_prev : e.versions[i]!.timestamp ≤ e.versions[e.versions.size - 2]!.timestamp := by
        have : i < te.versions.size := by omega
        have : (te.versions.size - 2) < te.versions.size := by omega
        apply h_sorted i (te.versions.size - 2) (by omega) this (by omega)
        rw [Array.get] at h_prev
      calc
        e.versions[i]!.timestamp ≤ e.versions[e.versions.size - 2]!.timestamp := h_prev
        _ ≤ ts := h_time
        _ = e.versions[j]!.timestamp := by simp [TemporalEdge.addVersion] at h; rfl
    . have : j < e.versions.size - 1 := by omega
      have h_mono := h_sorted i j h_ij (by omega) this
      rw [Array.get] at h_mono
      assumption

theorem edge_rollback_preserves_sorted (te : TemporalEdge) (h_sorted : IsSortedTimestampsEdge te.versions) (target : Nat) (h_t : target < te.versions.size) : IsSortedTimestampsEdge ((TemporalEdge.rollback te target).toOption.get!).versions := by
  cases h : te.rollback target
  case error e => contradiction
  case ok e =>
    intro i j h_ij h_i h_j
    simp [TemporalEdge.rollback, h] at h_i h_j
    have h_sub : i < te.versions.size ∧ j < te.versions.size := by
      constructor
      . calc i < target + 1 := by assumption
        _ ≤ te.versions.size := by apply Nat.succ_le_of_lt h_t
      . calc j < target + 1 := by assumption
        _ ≤ te.versions.size := by apply Nat.succ_le_of_lt h_t
    exact h_sorted i j h_ij h_sub.1 h_sub.2
